qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global engineering consultancy scale provides multidisciplinary breadth and complex RFP advantages, but professional services face competitive bidding, billable-rate limits, and massive M&A goodwill ($11.1B on $9.8B equity) that depresses multi-cycle GAAP ROIC to 8.7%, failing the 12% Gate 3b hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (REJECT). Serial engineering consultancy acquirer generates sub-hurdle multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (8.7% vs 12% requirement) due to heavy acquisition goodwill ($11.1B). Competitive hourly RFP bidding and exposure to professional billing wage inflation prevent true economic moat compounding.
qualitative.evidence: WSP Global's multi-cycle GAAP ROIC averages 8.68% (6.3% in 2022 to 10.2% in 2025), consistently below the 12.0% Gate 3b threshold. The business operates as an acquisitive roll-up in engineering and environmental consulting, accumulating $11.1B in goodwill and intangibles on $9.8B in equity. Professional services contracts are subject to competitive RFP tenders with pricing power limited to cost-plus wage adjustments.
